results.title: Arjun Bijlani on socializing in showbiz: ‘I value genuine connections more than being seen everywhere’
results.description: In a candid discussion, Arjun Bijlani shares insights into the entertainment industry's social landscape, emphasizing quality over quantity in relationships. He believes that meaningful connections surpass the need to be seen at every event. While he values networking opportunities, Arjun insists that his artistry should take center stage. Acknowledging social media's role, he commits to maintaining a profile that authentically reflects his values and hard-earned talent.

results.title: Bank strike from Sept 28–30 meets month-end: 5 easy money tasks to finish before bank branches shut for three days
results.description: Imagine reaching the bank on September 29 because you suddenly need a cheque cleared, a document updated or some cash for an important payment, only to find the branch closed. And this time, it isn't just a regular bank holiday. A three-day nationwide bank strike has been called from September 28 to 30, right at the end of the month.The timing makes it a little more inconvenient for households. September 30 is also the half-yearly financial closing date, while the strike comes after the September 26-27 weekend. The government has therefore allowed public-sector and regional rural banks to open on Sunday, September 27, so customers can finish important work before the strike.So, if there's a banking task you've been postponing, this is probably a good time to check it.
